FORBIDDEN_EVENT: Notifications can only be published by the server.
AUTH_REQUIRED: Authentication required. Sign in before reconnecting.
AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Authentication could not be verified. Reconnect manually.
CONNECTION_REJECTED: Connection rejected. Verify access before reconnecting.
CONNECTION_FAILED: Connection failed. Check the backend and server URL.
RETRY_EXHAUSTED: Automatic reconnection stopped after 8 attempts. Select Connect to retry.
DISCONNECTED: Connect to the server before sending.
ACK_TIMEOUT: Server acknowledgment timed out or connection was interrupted.
